[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## REQ-SRP-006 (Milan 4.2.7.3, 4.3.2, 4.4.1, shall) - audit verdict PARTIAL

MVRP: a talker joins the stream VLAN before it sends any stream frame, and a listener declares the VID of its settled sinks.

- In `hdl/` today: Talker: gate open -> VLAN user++ with the stream VID (hdl/srp/KL_srp_talker_fsm.sv:739, user face) ; listener: settle -> user++ with the settled VID (KL_srp_listener_fsm.sv user face, F10.5); refcounted per-VID membership and MVRP New/JoinIn/Lv in hdl/srp/KL_srp_vlan.sv; lanes muxed at hdl/srp/KL_srp_top.sv:367-389,615-617. The streaming licence is hdl/srp/KL_srp_talker_fsm.sv:786-789: active_o = declaring (incl. VP/VN, :337-339) AND Ready/ReadyFailed registered AND admitted - it has NO term for 'the MVRP join of vid_r[s] has been transmitted'.
- In `tb/` today: Talker half: tb/srp_stream_fsms/sim_main.cpp:573-575 (user++ with VID on open, not ACTIVE before Ready), tb/srp_encoder V1..V9 (KL_srp_vlan refcount, New then JoinIn, Lv on last user), tb/srp_top/sim_main.cpp:568-577 and tb/pp_top S2 (:7885-7888) MVRP VID 2 New byte-exact. Listener half: only module level - tb/srp_stream_fsms/sim_main.cpp:629-631 (user++ with the settled VID), :701 (user-- on teardown). In tb/srp_top D (:638) the sink uses VID 2 while source 1 still holds VID 2, so the listener lane produces no wire action and nothing is asserted; tb/pp_top has a single MVRP check (S2, talker).
- Missing: (1) Ordering is neither enforced nor graded: active_o can rise as soon as a Listener Ready is registered after gate-open, up to one T-MRP-JOIN (200 ms) before the MVRP New for that VID (and the Advertise) reach the wire; no test asserts 'MVRP join transmitted before active_o'. (2) The listener-side VID declaration is never graded on the wire through KL_srp_top/pp_top (the listener user lane of the mux at KL_srp_top.sv:367-370 could be cut with no MVRP check failing); no scenario settles a sink on a VID no talker already holds, nor checks the MVRP Lv when that last sink tears down.
- Searched with: user_join|user_vid|vlan_user|vu_sel_ls; MVRP|q_mvrp|vid_active; active_o|app_declaring_f; VLAN user|user++ (confidence: medium)

## Acceptance

1. tb/srp_top: DECLARE_LISTENER on a VID no source holds (e.g. VID 7) yields a byte-exact MVRP VID 7 New, then JoinIn on the cadence; WITHDRAW_LISTENER of the last user yields MVRP Lv of VID 7
2. tb/srp_top: a Listener Ready injected immediately after DECLARE_TALKER (before the first join tick) must not raise active_o before the MVRP New for the stream VID has been captured on the wire; either the RTL gates active_o on the VLAN FSM having transmitted the join or the docs record why the window is acceptable
3. Mutation: forcing vu_sel_ls_w to 0 (listener lane cut) turns the suite red

Matrix finding link: GAP-04.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
